client_service_reconciliation.interpretation: Socket/wakeup/response overhead is small at this boundary. Service-side native synchronization, replay, and coherent mirror work explain almost all client blocking time.

rejected_shortcuts: Do not remove or poll around the successful infinite wait-all timeline waits.
Do not attribute the remaining performance gap to socket latency.
Do not claim that mirror elimination alone can close the roughly 31-FPS direct-path gap.
